I can help you upgrade the cabin to business and add 2 checked bags. However, upgrading from economy to business may incur additional costs. Do you confirm these changes?
Yes, I understand there may be additional costs. I'm willing to pay up to $650 for the business class upgrade for all passengers. Please proceed with checking the availability and costs.
